dataset.name: MDACC progression-enriched lower-grade glioma cohort (GSE184941)
dataset.description: Independent lower-grade glioma cohort with bulk RNA sequencing of original grade II-III tumors and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: GSE184941 is a longitudinal, progression-enriched glioma series rather than an unselected population cohort. TRACE Explorer retains only source-labelled LGG libraries with at least 30% uniquely mapped reads, excludes all HGG libraries and one patient shared with the promoted GLASS release, and selects one technically highest-quality LGG library per remaining patient before endpoint QC.
dataset.publication_citation: Khan et al. International Journal of Cancer 2023; Ozbek et al. PeerJ 2023

metadata.source_program: Baylor College of Medicine and MD Anderson malignant-progression glioma cohort
metadata.library_method: Paired-end total RNA-seq from FFPE resected glioma tissue
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from the initial glioma diagnosis
metadata.redistribution_note: The GEO count matrix is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but direct matrix redistribution remains disabled because GEO access alone does not resolve all submitter intellectual-property claims.
metadata.overlap_control: Source patient 17 is excluded because its centre, sex, age, endpoint, initial grade and longitudinal pathology sequence identify it as GLSS-MD-0027, already represented in the promoted GLASS LGG release.
metadata.curation_note: GEO exposes 180 direct bulk RNA-seq libraries, including 79 labelled LGG. The source processing description excludes libraries below 30% uniquely mapped reads. Applying that threshold and the cross-release overlap exclusion leaves 57 eligible libraries from 49 patients. A prespecified rank selects the highest uniquely mapped fraction, then highest total mapped fraction, with GEO accession as the stable final tie-break. Four selected patients have missing OS and one has a negative OS value, leaving 44 patients, 25 deaths and 19 censored observations. Counts are normalized over all 60,609 released rows to log2(CPM + 1). Pinned GENCODE v36 maps 60,531 rows to 59,299 symbols; 110 symbols represented by multiple Ensembl rows are excluded rather than combined, leaving 59,189 unambiguous genes.

samples.sample_role: Original grade II-III glioma tissue in a progression-enriched longitudinal cohort

expression.label: GEO counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes each retained library size across all 60,609 pinned source rows, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are cohort-normalized and should not be compared directly with expression units from other releases.
